 Follow Is Veterans Day a Federal holiday? Is my trash pickup delayed in Georgia?
 Vanessa Johns, Savannah Morning News Tue, November 10, 2026 at 10:08 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Veterans Day is coming up Wednesday, Nov. 11, and Georgians planning errands, banking or trash pickup may want to check their schedules before the holiday.
 The federal holiday means some government offices and services will close for the day, but not every business or local service follows the same schedule. In Georgia, state government offices will be closed, post offices will shut their doors and garbage collection schedules will depend on the city.
 Here's what Georgia residents should know about what's open and closed on Veterans Day 2026.
 Is Veterans Day a federal holiday in 2026?
 Yes. Veterans Day is observed annually on Nov. 11, and in 2026 it falls on a Wednesday.
 Message of Veterans day with american flag background. Concept of Veteran day, Memorial Day or patriotism The holiday honors military veterans who served in the U.S. Armed Forces. It was originally known as Armistice Day, marking the end of fighting in World War I on Nov. 11, 1918.
 Will Georgia state offices be open on Veterans Day?
 No. State of Georgia government offices will be closed Wednesday, Nov. 11, in observance of Veterans Day, according to the Georgia Department of Administrative Services.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The state's 2026 holiday schedule also lists Veterans Day as a state holiday when the Georgia Capitol and state agencies will be closed.
 Will banks be open in Georgia on Nov. 11?
 Many bank branches will be closed for Veterans Day, but customers should check with their individual financial institutions before making a trip.
 Customers may still be able to access some services through online and mobile banking, as well as ATMs, depending on their bank.
 Will mail be delivered on Veterans Day?
 Post offices will be closed Monday, according to the U.S. Postal Service . However, FedEx and UPS will still be operating.
 Customers can still access certain services online at USPS and use self-service kiosks at select post office locations.
 Will trash pickup be delayed in Georgia?
 This depends on where you live. Georgia cities do not all follow the same holiday collection schedule, so residents should check their local sanitation department before putting their bins out.
 South Bend city trash can file art Residents in other communities should check their city or county's holiday schedule because collection changes can vary by service and location.
 Are Georgia schools open on Veterans Day?
 School schedules can vary by district, however, most public schools will be open. Parents and students should check their local school system's calendar to see whether classes will be held Wednesday, Nov. 11.
 What businesses are open on Veterans Day?
 While some may have modified hours, most businesses and retailers will be open. However, customers should check with individual locations before heading out.
